children: Meta Platforms (META) received a higher price target from Cantor Fitzgerald, which lifted its view to $860 from $680 while keeping an Overweight rating.

Analyst Deepak Mathivanan said personal AI agents could create a broad market for artificial intelligence. He estimated the opportunity at more than $1 trillion under a broad measure, while a narrower view based on subscriptions and commerce fees puts it above $250 billion.
Mathivanan also outlined a path toward a free-and-paid model for Muse. Cantor estimated the service currently costs Meta about 25 cents per task, or roughly $11 per average user each month.

The analyst expects AI processing expenses to decline by more than 80% over the next 18 to 24 months as higher usage and model improvements lower costs. He said that could help Meta move Muse toward profitability as the service scales.
Mathivanan also cited Muse's interface, which combines chat, a feed and recommendations, as a factor that could encourage usage. Meta introduced the personal AI agent earlier this month.

title: Veteran Analyst Resets Meta Stock Price Target For 2027
